**Discpress 1.3.2 brings back the full speed on iPhone and iPad.** 1.3.1 limited iPhones to 2 threads and iPads to 4, as a precaution against iOS's memory limit. That limit wasn't what closed the app: the share sheet was, and 1.3.1 fixed that separately. A thread takes only about 16 MB of memory.

## Download

**[⬇ discpress.html](https://github.com/PowerBeef/discpress/releases/download/v1.3.2/discpress.html)** (about 2.9 MB). The whole app in one file that works offline. To update, download it and use it instead of your old copy.

**Or use it online: [powerbeef.github.io/discpress](https://powerbeef.github.io/discpress/)**, the same file, published with each release. Best on iPhone and iPad; it updates itself.

## Changes

- **iPhones use up to 4 threads again, iPads up to 8.** As on other devices, a short speed test on the first conversion picks how many: it stops adding threads once another one no longer helps.
- **A speed test run under 1.3.1's limit runs again** on the next conversion, so iPhones and iPads that tested only up to 2 or 4 threads get a fresh measurement.

The CHDs are the same as 1.3.0's and 1.3.1's.
